t: This is the home of the Social Market Foundation, an independent think-tank based in Westminster. It was named UK Think Tank of the Year by Prospect in 2012. Its aim is to champion ideas that marry a pro-market outlook with concern for social justice, built on the idea of the social market economy. It was founded by Daniel Finkelstein, a journalist and Conservative peer who once advised Prime Minister John Major and the party leader William Hague.
